reviews.subject: docs: add signal forms examples to Checkbox and Chips (#33623)
reviews.decision: Complete sixteen-path patch read: upstream checkbox signal-form demo, two chip signal-field demo sets, existing chip form templates, exports and overview text. Existing reactive/template examples change tracking from keyword to index to permit duplicate values; new signal demos use FormField, disabled rules, explicit LiveAnnouncer calls and chipInput.clear. The signal-chip removal mutates an existing array before setting the same reference, so presence of this example is not proof of signal updates/announcements. No checkbox/chip implementation, original legacy forms/event contracts or declaration changes occur. These unshipped examples neither authorize adding modern signal APIs to legacy controls nor installing younger21 peers. All affected files are outside both package closures; actual original forms/accessibility behavior remains independently required.
